PlaceDetail.placeholderDesc: This is placeholder copy — it will be replaced with editor / community contributions in the next phase. Content may include history, visiting tips, seasonal notes, signature dishes (for food/cafe), best times for photos (for check-in), and related experiences.
heritageTips: Dress modestly when visiting historical sites.
Walk lightly and speak softly to respect the sacred space.
Bring small cash for entrance tickets or donations.
nightlifeTips: Reserve a table in advance on weekends for the best seats.
Bring an ID (national ID/passport) for age verification.
Dress code is usually smart casual — avoid flip-flops.
natureTips: Wear proper hiking shoes with good grip.
Bring a water bottle, sunscreen, and insect repellent.
Always check the weather forecast before heading out.
cafeTips: Golden hour and early morning have the best light for photos.
Try the signature item suggested on the menu.
Many alleyway cafés have limited motorbike parking — ask staff.
foodTips: Arrive early to avoid the rush-hour queue.
Most local eateries prefer cash or instant transfer payments.
Try the original flavour first before adding condiments.
defaultTips: Bring an offline map or GPS positioning when traveling.
Protect the environment — don't litter at the destination.
Ask locals for help if you need directions.
